programs.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted 2
programs.desc: The famous chef will learn about the cuisine, culture, traditions and history of inhabitants of distant corners of the world.The winner of several Michelin stars goes on exciting expeditions with the passion of an adventurer.To prepare local dishes, you will often need hard-to-find ingredients.To get them, he will even risk encountering poisonous creatures.He will dive, fish and even jump from a helicopter.This time he will travel through the plains of South Africa, the swamps of Louisiana, the Norwegian fjords, Sumatra and the mountains of southern India.It will also come to Tasmania.

programs.title: Lawless Island
programs.desc: The inhabitants of Prince of Wales Island fish, hunt and collect firewood.They have no roads, police or offices, but are threatened by wolves and bears.However, no one is thinking about returning to the city.
